name: dryrun_03_paper2_smoke
notes: Paper 2 pre-registration v0.4.1 (v0.1 design unchanged), Section 3 'Order of runs' item 1 and the Minute-budget row 'Smoke test' (0.4 min at 250 us, 3 s at 1 us in the v0.4.1 table; this list is the 9-circuit reset-kind subset), checked by Gate P2-2 (reset acted, delay did not; scheduled reset duration 400 ns; kill criteria 1 and 2) and by Gate P2-1 (c) after the Marrakesh dry run. The Q1 protocol on 12 qubits: (a) X -> reset kind -> measure and (b) reset kind -> measure for native reset, measure_reset and measure_reset_2, plus X -> delay(400 ns) -> measure (no-reset reference), X -> measure and measure alone (the day's readout confusion); 9 circuits x 1024 shots in one Estimator job at resilience 0 with one Z observable per qubit, P(1) = (1 - <Z>)/2. Qubits: one per lattice row, the lowest readout assignment error outside the pre-registered exclusion set on the 2026-09-19T155931Z snapshot (9, 12, 21, 38, 43, 50, 69, 78, 81, 97, 108, 110). measure_reset / measure_reset_2 are taken from backend.target on ibm_phoenix; the fake backend of the dry run lacks them, so the runner adds opaque one-qubit instructions and flags them as synthetic_target_instructions in job.json. Primitive: the runner has no SamplerV2 path (EstimatorV2 only, one job per resilience level / probe group), so this smoke list keeps EstimatorV2 <Z> with P(1) = (1 - <Z>)/2 and the Estimator's default init_qubits, as recorded in the Paper 2 pre-registration v0.4.1 Section 3 'Execution' row ('the Marrakesh dry-run list 03 currently estimates the reset-error map as EstimatorV2 <Z>; the production lists will use SamplerV2 with init_qubits as pre-registered here ... or a Deviation is recorded before October'). The production Q1-Q5 lists need SamplerV2 with init_qubits logged per job (raw counts, init_qubits flag), which is a runner follow-up before Q1; until it lands, the Estimator estimate of the smoke test is the deviation to record in the Paper 2 ledger. Layout check (Paper 1 Deviation 26 cuts) is logged for the 12 bare qubits (readout, operational, init error; no couplers) and enforced on the submitting path. Nothing is submitted while dry_run is true and the pre-flight review permalink is TBD. Budget model v2 (post-run review D1, 2026-09-19): 0.074 min at 250 us, 0.035 min at 1 us (no TREX: resilience 0 only).

probes.purpose: Q1 (a) native reset: P(1 | X, reset, measure)
Q1 (e) no-reset reference: P(1 | X, delay 400 ns, measure) should exceed 0.9 (Gate P2-2)

budget.formula: 2 s per job + (rep_delay + L x 0.71 us + t_meas + 10 us [+ dial durations]) x executions x (3 if resilience 2) + [resilience >= 1] x 32 x shots x n_bases x (rep_delay + t_meas + 10 us)
